Article • 10/30/2024
Applies to:
Microsoft Defender XDR
If you're new to Microsoft Defender XDR and Defender Experts for Hunting:
1. Upon getting your welcome email, select Log into Microsoft Defender XDR.
2. Sign in if you already have a Microsoft account. If none, create one.
3. The Microsoft Defender XDR quick tour gets you familiar with the security suite,
where the capabilities are and how important they are. Select Take a quick tour.
4. Read the short descriptions about what the Microsoft Defender Experts service is
and the capabilities it provides. Select Next. You see the welcome page:
